consequence.statement: Listed metrics are exposed with the `loki_` prefix instead of `cortex_`, so queries, dashboards or alerts using the old names will not match unless metrics_namespace is set to `cortex`.
consequence.remediation: Set metrics_namespace to `cortex` to keep old names, or update dashboards and alerts.
